evidence.quote: The preparations for exit will allow us to move with confidence when the time is right. They do not push us toward the door.

the relatively modest pace of recovery, the continued high rate of unemployment, subdued inflation trends, and well-anchored inflation expectations together suggest that the need for highly accommodative monetary policies will not diminish soon.
I would be very cautious about any exit strategy that includes early asset sales.
the completion of preparatory steps need not be followed in short order by the initiation of tightening measures.
During the current economic downturn, community banks have been particularly hard hit.
